title: Inherit global setting for "Navigation wraps around", rather than having its own
line: Scrolling on the Pager now wraps around exactly when the virtual desktop "Navigation wraps around" setting in System Settings is on.
explanation: The Pager widget had its own "Navigation wraps around" checkbox (off by default) that only affected scrolling on the pager, while keyboard and KWin desktop switching follow the global virtual desktop setting, so the two could disagree. libtaskmanager already exposes the global value as VirtualDesktopInfo.navigationWrappingAround, but the public object never forwarded its change signal, so a QML binding on it kept whatever value it first read. The libtaskmanager change forwards that signal; the pager now uses the global value for scrolling and hides its own checkbox, which stays for the Activity Pager since activities have no global equivalent.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: forward navigationWrappingAroundChanged

VirtualDesktopInfo forwarded every signal of its shared private object
but this one, so QML bindings on navigationWrappingAround kept the first
value and missed changes to the global setting. Connect it as well.

BUG: 460806

applets/pager: follow the global wrap-around setting when scrolling

The pager had its own "Navigation wraps around" option for scrolling,
which could disagree with the virtual desktop setting used by keyboard
switching. Use the global one and keep the option only for activities.

BUG: 460806

patches.diff:
From ab5e930977e5b8c7f73415b2171899cc04ab1cd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:12:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] libtaskmanager: forward navigationWrappingAroundChanged

VirtualDesktopInfo forwarded every signal of its shared private object
but this one, so QML bindings on navigationWrappingAround kept the first
value and missed changes to the global setting. Connect it as well.

BUG: 460806
---
 libtaskmanager/virtualdesktopinfo.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/libtaskmanager/virtualdesktopinfo.cpp b/libtaskmanager/virtualdesktopinfo.cpp
index 8f6381b962..737fa4a8d8 100644
--- a/libtaskmanager/virtualdesktopinfo.cpp
+++ b/libtaskmanager/virtualdesktopinfo.cpp
@@ -477,6 +477,7 @@ VirtualDesktopInfo::VirtualDesktopInfo(QObject *parent)
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::currentDesktopChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::currentDesktopChanged);
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::currentDesktopForScreenChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::currentDesktopForScreenChanged);
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::numberOfDesktopsChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::numberOfDesktopsChanged);
+    connect(d, qConstOverload<>(&VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::navigationWrappingAroundChanged), this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::navigationWrappingAroundChanged);
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::desktopIdsChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::desktopIdsChanged);
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::desktopNamesChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::desktopNamesChanged);
     connect(d, &VirtualDesktopInfo::Private::desktopPositionsChanged, this, &VirtualDesktopInfo::desktopPositionsChanged);
--

media.caption: Pager Settings on master: the pager has its own "Navigation wraps around" checkbox, separate from the virtual desktop setting
With the fix the checkbox is gone from the virtual desktop Pager; it follows System Settings > Virtual Desktops (also reachable from the pager's context menu)
Global "Navigation wraps around" on, pager option at its default: scrolling down on the pager stops at desktop 4
Same settings with the fix: scrolling down past desktop 4 wraps to desktop 1, like keyboard switching

reviews.text: Solid multi-repo fix that catches the real underlying bug in libtaskmanager (VirtualDesktopInfo never forwarded Private::navigationWrappingAroundChanged, leaving QML bindings stale) and cleanly wires the virtual desktop Pager to the global setting while keeping the per-applet checkbox for Activity Pager. Before/after screenshots and videos confirm live updates and Activity Pager isolation. Minor nit: the prerequisite plasma-workspace commit could use CCBUG: 460806 so Bugzilla does not close the bug before the plasma-desktop commit lands.

This does what the reporter asked and Nate agreed to: the virtual desktop Pager drops its own checkbox and scrolls with wrap-around only when the global KWin setting is on. That also removes the mismatch behind the long 1->2->3->4 animation the reporter described. The libtaskmanager one-liner is a real bug fix (VirtualDesktopInfo forwarded every Private signal except navigationWrappingAroundChanged; qConstOverload correctly picks the no-arg overload), and it is needed because the Private value starts at true until KWin's reply arrives. Keeping wrapPage for the Activity Pager, which has no global equivalent, is the right call. The evidence covers all four combinations, live updates and the Activity Pager, and the config screenshot has no leftover label.
